stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: gimbal boot/shaft exit on top of the base (grip connector above it)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the FFB-G joystick base alone (no grip) seen from the front left, slightly from above, grip connector on top
mappingSource: catalog brunner.json (source https://brunner-innovation.swiss/product/ffb-g-joystick/): JOY_X roll, JOY_Y pitch; the catalog note says the base is not a DirectInput joystick by itself (the grip's own USB device carries the buttons, FFB via CLS2Sim), Brunner publishes no axis map
note: The photo shows the base without a grip; the gimbal is marked at the boot where the grip shaft leaves the base.
